svg.text: PR #116 and #117 research vs unchanged FAST separate: all 74 metrics
Green: lower error. Red: higher error. White: near parity. Compare each candidate with its own seed reference.
A refinement includes its input FAST construction cost. Extra-budget controls are shown; this is not a same-cost comparison.
Spatial/temporal feature guards do not guarantee all individual metrics. No rendered-scene or universal state-of-the-art claim.
